title: Field-service platform for contractors
summary: Jobs, estimates, invoices, scheduling, timesheets and forms for construction crews. Offline-first, with local storage and a persisted sync queue; one codebase for iOS, Android, macOS and Windows, with code push.

title: Infrastructure monitoring platform
summary: Monitoring for railways and dams: mobile apps for field teams and inspectors with offline maps and sync, plus the backend and the web control room.

title: City issue tracking for councils
summary: A patrol app that helps city councils find, log and follow up issues across the city, with maps and offline sync for teams in the field.

title: Athlete training & team performance platform
summary: Mobile and web apps for teams and coaches, with a custom video player, shared UI kit and backend in one monorepo with CI/CD.

title: Nutrition & diet-tracking app
summary: A modular Flutter monorepo for a consumer health app: feature packages, shared core and a design system documented in Widgetbook.

title: Offline companion for technical documentation
summary: A mobile companion that keeps industrial documentation available without a connection.

title: Field operations app with offline maps
summary: A field app with maps and local storage for teams working away from a connection.

title: Car marketplace member app
summary: A member app for customers to find their favourite cars, alongside a companion store.

title: Voice AI app
summary: A mobile app and an upload service for a voice AI product.

title: Consumer social app with an in-app camera
summary: A social app for iOS, Android and web, plus a standalone camera SDK.

title: Real-time video social app
summary: A social app with live video calls on iOS, Android and web.

title: CRM & invoicing SaaS mobile app
summary: The mobile client of a business SaaS: contacts, opportunities, documents, dashboard and global search, built as feature modules.

title: Restaurant operations platform
summary: A mobile app, admin panel, web confirmation flow and Firebase backend for hospitality teams.

title: Social video app
summary: A consumer app and a manager app on a shared core, with an event-driven Firebase and Pub/Sub backend.

title: Health research app
summary: A mobile app for collecting data in health studies.

title: Social quiz app with its own intelligence engine
summary: A social network and quiz app in one, designed and built end to end: UI/UX and the marketing site, mobile and web apps, an admin panel, a Firebase backend and a custom intelligence service, built from scratch in 2020, before today’s AI tools existed.

title: Ride-hailing apps
summary: Rider and driver apps for a ride-hailing service.

title: Travel app for parents
summary: A travel planning app built for families.

title: Legal document editor
summary: A document editor for legal work on web and macOS.

title: Configurator for industrial control electronics
summary: A Windows and Android app for a hydraulics manufacturer’s control boards: set and read parameters, stream live values and record signals into charts, talking to the hardware over USB serial and Bluetooth LE with Protobuf messages.

title: Chat & campaigns app with a gRPC backend
summary: A consumer chat app with paid campaigns, in-app coins and moderation, backed by a gRPC API on Cloud Run, Firebase, an admin web tool and its own CI.

title: Comic reader app
summary: A comic-book reading app for iOS and Android, built on a gRPC API and shipped to the App Store.
